+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+
+set -uo pipefail
+cd /testbed || exit 1
+base64 -d mimo_build_env.tar.gz.b64 | tar -xzf - -C /testbed || exit 1
+exec bash -lc 'cd /testbed && bash -eo pipefail /testbed/.build_env/test_command.sh'
diff --git a/tests/sequence/test_repair_fasta_alignment_seq_type.py b/tests/sequence/test_repair_fasta_alignment_seq_type.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/sequence/test_repair_fasta_alignment_seq_type.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import sys
+if '/testbed/src' not in sys.path:
+    sys.path.insert(0, '/testbed/src')
+
+import biotite.sequence as seq
+import biotite.sequence.io.fasta as fasta
+
+
+def test_get_alignment_respects_forced_protein_seq_type():
+    ff = fasta.FastaFile()
+    ff['p1'] = 'ACGT-ACGT'
+    ff['p2'] = 'ACGTACGT-'
+    alignment = fasta.get_alignment(ff, seq_type=seq.ProteinSequence)
+    assert [type(s) for s in alignment.sequences] == [
+        seq.ProteinSequence,
+        seq.ProteinSequence,
+    ]
+    assert [str(s) for s in alignment.sequences] == ['ACGTACGT', 'ACGTACGT']
+
+
+def test_get_sequence_autodetect_uppercases_and_normalizes_rna():
+    ff = fasta.FastaFile()
+    ff['n1'] = 'acgtu'
+    detected = fasta.get_sequence(ff)
+    assert isinstance(detected, seq.NucleotideSequence)
+    assert detected == seq.NucleotideSequence('ACGTT')

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
if [ -x /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  PATH=/opt/test_venv/bin:$PATH
  export PATH
  python() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
  python3() { /opt/test_venv/bin/python3 "$@"; }
fi
/opt/biotite-venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/sequence/test_repair_fasta_alignment_seq_type.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
